title: Page 106
transc:
Yorktown May 3 , 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
for Chaff her please agree upon
some signal light which the rear
boat containing landing material for General
Heckmans pilgrim shall carry in order
to notify general Wistar at grove
lading when and where to fall
into line signs Smith good night
HN Snow


Hd Qrs A. of P. May 2nd 1864 
7.10 PM
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Lucy John J Davenport I have a
man not late from Galway who can
perhaps explain recent obstructions to the shelters
correspondent with Garden if they still exist
does the shelter want the man and
will he be sent right back let
me know what you consider the condition
of things at Galway and what you
know about any whinny passing through garden
this way for the past Federal days
youth Elgin blows and rains hard of
Caldwell
